cause_quote: PR #148790 added `source: "channel-owner"` to the capability created by `createCronCreatorAuthorityCapability(authorityRunId, ...)`, binding the new management entitlement to the ingress run that settles before queued execution.
user_saw: An authenticated channel owner saw only the current conversation’s automations when their request waited in the followup queue.
summary: The fix carries a source-bound capability factory through the followup queue and uses it to restore gateway-wide automation management for the queued run if the sender is still an owner.
reasoning: The introducing diff extended gateway-wide automation management from Control UI administrators to configured channel owners and required a live entitlement tied to the executing run ID. I checked that the queue already existed in that revision and that it executed the saved followup under its own run ID without creating a fresh owner capability, so the queued path was broken when channel-owner management shipped.
